children: Rays of Belief Limited raises INR 1,249.97 million from an initial public offering (IPO) of equity shares comprising of a fresh issue of 5,230,000 equity shares of face value INR 10 each.
Luthra Law Offices India advises Rays of Belief Limited and Mefcom Capital Markets Limited on this IPO.

The transaction team comprised of Partner Akshit Kapoor, Managing Associate Kshitij Asthana and Senior Associate Naman Dubey, along with Associates, Ashutosh Anand, Ashwin Singh, Karan Kapoor, Kumar Anant Ashish, Manali Singh, Savar Arora, Shashwat Tyagi and Swetapadma Priyadarshini.

Rays of Belief Limited operates India’s largest network of centres dedicated to intervention plans for children with neurodevelopmental disorders, with 136 centres across 20 states and union territories. The IPO was pursued through the ‘Confidential Pre-Filing Route’ under Chapter IIA of the SEBI ICDR Regulations.

It is pertinent to mention that the transaction represents a landmark issuance under India’s social enterprise capital markets framework and is extremely significant as Rays of Belief Limited is the first “For Profit Social Enterprise” to list in India under Regulation 292(E) of the SEBI ICDR Regulations.
